name: SWEETHEART I LOVE YOU
source:
"One... Two... Three..."
 "..."
"Four... Five..."
"Six."
"There are only six trees."
"Arranged in a row."
"Exactly the same. Not different in any way."
"There is nothing special about them, but still, there is something extraordinary."

---

Play as a college student and experience her world.

Everything isn't as calm as it looks.. Eventually, that suffocating loneliness is going to eat you up from the inside.

[From [url=https://romono-a.itch.io/sweetheart-i-love-you]Itch.io[/url]]
